Effect magnitudes and full interval widths for all twelve primary endpoints. Log-display floor is 1e-16 only; original values are preserved in the source table.

Six interactions from genuinely nested per-turn speed menus, low .75/1.0 and high .75/1.0/1.3. Five support complementarity; head-on against a flexible opponent reverses. This limited-horizon check is separate from the forced-speed primary experiment.
